_comment: Recommendation templates (FR-23). Each states only the expected DIRECTION of impact on the indicator that triggered it. Phase 1 has no validated model for quantified temperature reductions, so no magnitude is claimed.

add_vegetation.title: Add or preserve vegetation and tree canopy
add_vegetation.intervention: Increase planted area and tree canopy in exposed open spaces, streets and parking; preserve existing vegetation.
add_vegetation.expected_direction: Likely to increase the green-space proportion and vegetation indicator, and likely to lower surface temperatures of the treated surfaces. Magnitude is not quantified in Phase 1.
tradeoffs: May conflict with circulation or parking space
add_vegetation.evaluation_method: Create an alternative scenario with the proposed green areas/trees (with canopy sizes) and compare green-space proportion and shade indicators against the baseline; after implementation, re-check NDVI and LST on new satellite scenes.

reduce_hard_surface.title: Reduce unnecessary hard-surface coverage
reduce_hard_surface.intervention: Replace surplus asphalt/paving (e.g. oversized parking or carriageways) with planted or permeable surfaces, or higher-albedo paving where hard surfaces are required.
reduce_hard_surface.expected_direction: Likely to reduce the hard-surface proportion. Effect on surface temperature depends on the replacement material and is not quantified in Phase 1.
required_inputs: Areas of paving that can be changed
reduce_hard_surface.evaluation_method: Compare hard-surface and green-space proportions between the baseline and an alternative scenario with reduced paving.

shade_public_space.title: Introduce shade in exposed public and open spaces
shade_public_space.intervention: Add shade structures, colonnades or trees along main pedestrian routes and in plazas/playgrounds exposed during hot afternoons.
shade_public_space.expected_direction: Likely to increase the shaded share of open space at the analysed times. Effect on thermal comfort is not modelled in Phase 1.
required_inputs: Tree positions, heights and canopy sizes
tradeoffs: Reduced winter sun where winters are cold
shade_public_space.evaluation_method: Add the shade elements (with heights) to an alternative scenario and compare open-space sun exposure and shade-duration metrics against the baseline.

review_orientation.title: Review building arrangement and spacing around open spaces
review_orientation.intervention: Consider arranging buildings so that key open spaces fall within building shade in the afternoon (e.g. east/west of taller blocks, depending on latitude).
review_orientation.expected_direction: May increase geometric shade on selected open spaces; may reduce solar access elsewhere.
tradeoffs: Daylight and solar access to buildings
review_orientation.evaluation_method: Model an alternative layout as a scenario and compare shade metrics at 09:00/12:00/15:00 solar time.

review_compliance.title: Review the design against the verified planning requirement
review_compliance.intervention: Adjust the design (or confirm a permitted exception with the authority) so that the verified planning requirement is met.
review_compliance.expected_direction: Brings the checked indicator within the verified limit.
tradeoffs: May reduce built area or change the programme
review_compliance.evaluation_method: Create an alternative scenario and re-run the planning check.

resolve_data_gap.title: Provide the missing input
resolve_data_gap.intervention: Supply the missing or unverified information listed in the finding.
resolve_data_gap.expected_direction: Enables a more complete and reliable assessment.
resolve_data_gap.evaluation_method: Re-run the readiness check and analysis.
